modelingNotes: Camp North End: the Bunkhouse — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-cne-bunkhouse.ts

A small gabled house among the depot's buildings, 270 Camp Road, beside the north-west corner of `clt-cne-201-camp-road`; Camp North End calls it the Bunkhouse (3,400 sq ft). Probably the "dwelling for Army staff" the 2019 designation report lists among the depot's smaller buildings; that identification is not confirmed. A one-storey house 11 × 28 m under a slate-grey gabled roof running along its length, a narrower gabled extension at the north-east end, a cross-gabled wing on the west side and a small flat-roofed porch on the east.
Identity: the only pitched-roof house on the campus, its dark roof among the white flat roofs.

Evidence: - OSM: the outline way/324608458 ("Bunkhouse at Camp North End", height 5) and its parts way/901294559 (gabled, height 5) and way/835852293 (gabled, height 4.5, the west wing). - Lidar, USGS 3DEP NC Phase 4 Mecklenburg 2016, 1 m (measured, NAVD88): ground 228.3–229.0 (y = 0 is 228.3); ridge 233.6 (5.3 m), running along the long axis on its centre line; eaves 232.0–232.5 (about 3.8 m). A tree over its north-west side clutters the returns there. - USGS NAIP orthophoto (public domain): the slate-grey roof, its plan. - Camp North End leasing brochure (2021, camp.nc): "Bunkhouse", 3,400 sq ft. Mecklenburg County tax parcel 07903102 (CAMP LANDOWNER LP), 1943–55.
No licensed photo was found. The wall finish (drawn in the campus brick), the windows and doors are estimated; the wing's and extension's roof heights are from OSM's 4.5 m, scaled to the lidar.

Frame: the south warehouses' grid, y along bearing 39.13° (the outline's axis), placement bearing 39.13; origin at the outline's centroid, lng −80.8332717, lat 35.2462969. Kit: `clt-cne-301-camp-road.ts`.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "clt-cne-bunkhouse", model "clt-cne-bunkhouse"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/a1974bbf738c6994edbe99a7a61818b9d69da9e0/generators/clt-cne-bunkhouse.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
